wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: One row, 500.00, equals cover line 1 in BOTH the THIS and the CUMULATIVE column (LAST-REPORT is a slashed-O with a stroke, i.e. a zero glyph, so this is the only report of the cycle and the two scopes coincide). Cover line 2 - the never-itemized $50-or-less aggregate - is a zero glyph in all three columns, so there is no small-donor amount outside the itemisation; reconciling against line 1 alone is therefore also the whole story here. The Carr form prints NO schedule total on Form A; the cover line is the only anchor. The THIS and CUMULATIVE cells are written '500.' with a superscript 'oo' cents group over a short rule = 500.00.

expenditures.detail: Two rows, 112.75 + 385.20 = 497.95, equal cover line 3 in BOTH the THIS and the CUMULATIVE column (LAST-REPORT is a zero glyph), so the two scopes coincide and scope is recorded cumulative. The Carr Form B prints no schedule total; the cover line is the only anchor.

gates.page_subtotal: neither Carr schedule prints a subtotal or a total. p2 rows 500.00 = cover line 1 (500.00 THIS and CUMULATIVE); p3 rows 112.75 + 385.20 = 497.95 = cover line 3 (497.95 THIS and CUMULATIVE). Both gate EXACTLY.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py --dpi 200 returns geometry_status 'ok' with 36 bands on p2 and 36 on p3 - the ~35 writing lines plus the header band. Scored against INK, not bands: p2 has ink in exactly 1 band (plus a wrapped 'INC' continuation of the same contributor's name on the line below, which is NOT a second row - it carries no date, no amount and no digits) = 1 row emitted; p3 has ink in exactly 2 bands = 2 rows emitted.
gates.geometry_proof: p2 first-row box (pct:81.80,9.77,12.74,3.03) crops to '$500.oo'; it is also the last row; control one row-pitch below renders EMPTY (a single bare rule and three specks of scanner dust). p3 first-row box (pct:81.80,9.47,12.74,2.58) crops to '$112.75', last-row box (pct:81.80,12.05,12.74,2.73) crops to '$385.20', and the control one pitch below the last row renders EMPTY.
gates.balance_chain: CLOSES EXACTLY: 0 (nothing from a prior report) + 500.00 contributions - 497.95 expenditures = 2.05, and cover line 4 prints 2.05 in both the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns. This is the only filing in the chunk whose cover balance line is internally consistent. Its line-4 LAST-REPORT cell is genuinely BLANK (verified in a 600 dpi crop - lines 1, 2 and 3 all carry a visible zero glyph in that column, line 4 carries nothing), which is a DIFFERENT fact from a zero and is recorded as such.
